name: Media Library Favorites
description: Adds a favorite toggle to the media library view.
project_description:
This module provides users with a quick and easy way to add their favourite media to media fields.

 Users can favourite items directly from the Media Library and access these from a "Favourites" link which appears in the Media Library modal alongside the core "Grid" and "Table" views, showing only the current users favourite media for the allowed bundles.

 Features 
 Provides:

 
 An easy to use interface for selecting/unselecting media favourites on a per user basis. 
 A Views display within the Media Library View to display media favourites for the current user.
 A Views filter to display favourited media for the current user. 
 A Views field displaying a link to favourite/unfavourite a media item 
 
 Post-Installation 
 Assign user permissions to allow users to Favourite media items.
